examples.src: The city is famous for its cultural heritage.
examples.dst: 这座城市以其文化遗产而闻名。

examples.src: Cultural exchange helps people understand each other.
examples.dst: 文化交流有助于人们相互理解。

examples.src: We visited a cultural center last weekend.
examples.dst: 上周末我们参观了一个文化中心。

confuse.diff: cultural 是形容词，意为文化的；culture 是名词，意为文化。

examples.src: The museum keeps many relics from the Tang Dynasty.
examples.dst: 这家博物馆保存着许多唐朝的文物。

examples.src: These ancient relics must be protected.
examples.dst: 这些古代遗物必须得到保护。

examples.src: Archaeologists found a relic buried deep in the ground.
examples.dst: 考古学家发现了一件深埋在地下的遗物。

confuse.diff: relic 指遗物、文物；relief 指缓解、宽慰。

examples.src: This is a rare species of bird.
examples.dst: 这是一种稀有的鸟类。

examples.src: It is rare to see snow in this city.
examples.dst: 在这座城市很少能看到雪。

examples.src: He owns a rare book from the 18th century.
examples.dst: 他拥有一本18世纪的珍本书。

confuse.diff: rare 意为稀有的；rear 意为后面的或抚养。

examples.src: Time is more valuable than money.
examples.dst: 时间比金钱更宝贵。

examples.src: The thief stole several valuable paintings.
examples.dst: 小偷偷走了几幅贵重的画。

examples.src: She gave me valuable advice on my studies.
examples.dst: 她就我的学习给了我宝贵的建议。

confuse.diff: valuable 意为有价值的；invaluable 意为无价的，极其宝贵的。

examples.src: Only two people survived the accident.
examples.dst: 只有两个人在事故中幸存。

examples.src: Many old buildings survived the war.
examples.dst: 许多老建筑在战争中保存了下来。

examples.src: Plants cannot survive without water.
examples.dst: 植物没有水就无法存活。

confuse.diff: survive 意为幸存；survey 意为调查。

examples.src: She put the roses in a vase.
examples.dst: 她把玫瑰花插进花瓶里。

examples.src: The vase fell off the table and broke.
examples.dst: 花瓶从桌子上掉下来摔碎了。

examples.src: This Ming vase is worth a fortune.
examples.dst: 这只明代花瓶价值连城。

confuse.diff: vase 意为花瓶；base 意为基础、底部。

examples.src: The Tang Dynasty was a golden age of Chinese culture.
examples.dst: 唐朝是中国文化的黄金时代。

examples.src: The Qing Dynasty ended in 1912.
examples.dst: 清朝于1912年结束。

examples.src: We are learning about the Han Dynasty in history class.
examples.dst: 我们在历史课上学习汉朝。

confuse.diff: dynasty 意为朝代；dynamic 意为有活力的。

examples.src: The Taj Mahal is located in Agra, India.
examples.dst: 泰姬陵位于印度阿格拉。

examples.src: Millions of tourists visit the Taj Mahal every year.
examples.dst: 每年有数百万游客参观泰姬陵。

examples.src: The Taj Mahal was built in memory of an emperor's wife.
examples.dst: 泰姬陵是为纪念一位皇帝的妻子而建造的。

examples.src: Trading in ivory is illegal in many countries.
examples.dst: 在许多国家买卖象牙是违法的。

examples.src: The box is decorated with ivory.
examples.dst: 这个盒子用象牙装饰。

examples.src: She wore an ivory dress to the party.
examples.dst: 她穿着一件象牙色的连衣裙参加聚会。

confuse.diff: ivory 意为象牙；iron 意为铁。

examples.src: The dragon is a symbol of power in Chinese culture.
examples.dst: 龙在中国文化中是权力的象征。

examples.src: People watch dragon boat races during the festival.
examples.dst: 人们在节日期间观看龙舟比赛。

examples.src: In the story, a brave knight fought a fire-breathing dragon.
examples.dst: 故事中，一位勇敢的骑士与一条喷火龙搏斗。

confuse.diff: dragon 意为龙；dragonfly 意为蜻蜓。

examples.src: The necklace is made of amber.
examples.dst: 这条项链是用琥珀制成的。

examples.src: The Amber Room was a famous treasure of Russia.
examples.dst: 琥珀屋曾是俄罗斯著名的珍宝。

examples.src: The traffic light turned amber.
examples.dst: 交通信号灯变成了黄色。

confuse.diff: amber 意为琥珀；ember 意为余烬。

examples.src: They went into the forest in search of food.
examples.dst: 他们进入森林寻找食物。

examples.src: Many young people move to big cities in search of jobs.
examples.dst: 许多年轻人搬到大城市寻找工作。

examples.src: The explorers traveled far in search of the lost city.
examples.dst: 探险者们远行去寻找那座失落的城市。

confuse.diff: in search of 是固定搭配；in search for 不是规范用法。

means: 普鲁士（欧洲历史上的王国）

examples.src: Prussia was once a powerful kingdom in Europe.
examples.dst: 普鲁士曾经是欧洲一个强大的王国。

examples.src: The King of Prussia gave the Amber Room to the Russian czar.
examples.dst: 普鲁士国王把琥珀屋送给了俄国沙皇。

examples.src: Königsberg was an important city in Prussia.
examples.dst: 柯尼斯堡曾是普鲁士的一座重要城市。

confuse.diff: Prussia 是历史上的普鲁士；Russia 是俄罗斯。

examples.src: His talent never fails to amaze me.
examples.dst: 他的才华总是让我惊叹。

examples.src: The magician amazed the audience with his tricks.
examples.dst: 魔术师用他的戏法让观众大为惊奇。

examples.src: It amazes me that she finished the work so quickly.
examples.dst: 她这么快就完成了工作，让我很惊讶。

confuse.diff: amaze 意为使惊奇；amuse 意为使开心。

examples.src: The view from the top of the mountain is amazing.
examples.dst: 从山顶看到的景色令人惊叹。

examples.src: She has an amazing memory.
examples.dst: 她有惊人的记忆力。

examples.src: What an amazing story!
examples.dst: 多么不可思议的故事啊！

confuse.diff: amazing 修饰事物，意为令人惊奇的；amazed 修饰人，意为感到惊奇的。

examples.src: Please select a gift from the list.
examples.dst: 请从清单中挑选一件礼物。

examples.src: She was selected to represent the school.
examples.dst: 她被选中代表学校参赛。

examples.src: Only a select group of students can join the program.
examples.dst: 只有一小部分精选的学生能参加这个项目。

confuse.diff: select 指从多个中挑选；elect 指选举。

examples.src: I like to put honey in my tea.
examples.dst: 我喜欢在茶里加蜂蜜。

examples.src: Bees make honey from flowers.
examples.dst: 蜜蜂用花蜜酿造蜂蜜。

examples.src: Honey, could you pass me the salt?
examples.dst: 亲爱的，你能把盐递给我吗？

confuse.diff: honey 意为蜂蜜；money 意为钱。

examples.src: She designed her own wedding dress.
examples.dst: 她自己设计了婚纱。

examples.src: The design of the new bridge is very modern.
examples.dst: 这座新桥的设计非常现代。

examples.src: This software is designed for beginners.
examples.dst: 这款软件是为初学者设计的。

confuse.diff: design 意为设计；desire 意为渴望。

examples.src: They had dinner in a fancy restaurant.
examples.dst: 他们在一家高档餐厅吃了晚饭。

examples.src: Do you fancy a cup of coffee?
examples.dst: 你想来杯咖啡吗？

examples.src: She wore a fancy hat to the wedding.
examples.dst: 她戴着一顶花哨的帽子参加婚礼。

confuse.diff: fancy 指一时的喜好或幻想；fantasy 指奇幻、幻想作品。

examples.src: I like the style of this dress.
examples.dst: 我喜欢这件连衣裙的款式。

examples.src: Each writer has his own writing style.
examples.dst: 每位作家都有自己的写作风格。

examples.src: The house is built in the traditional Chinese style.
examples.dst: 这座房子是按中国传统风格建造的。

confuse.diff: style 意为风格；stale 意为不新鲜的。

examples.src: We decorated the Christmas tree with lights.
examples.dst: 我们用彩灯装饰圣诞树。

examples.src: They decorated the classroom for the party.
examples.dst: 他们为聚会布置了教室。

examples.src: She decorated the cake with fresh fruit.
examples.dst: 她用新鲜水果装饰蛋糕。

confuse.diff: decorate 是动词，意为装饰；decorative 是形容词，意为装饰性的。

examples.src: The crown was covered with jewels.
examples.dst: 这顶王冠上镶满了宝石。

examples.src: She keeps her jewels in a small box.
examples.dst: 她把珠宝放在一个小盒子里。

examples.src: The museum's greatest jewel is a blue diamond.
examples.dst: 这家博物馆最珍贵的宝物是一颗蓝钻。

confuse.diff: jewel 指单颗宝石；jewelry 是珠宝首饰的总称。

examples.src: The artist spent three years on this painting.
examples.dst: 这位画家花了三年时间完成这幅画。

examples.src: My uncle is a street artist.
examples.dst: 我叔叔是一名街头艺术家。

examples.src: She dreams of becoming a famous artist.
examples.dst: 她梦想成为一名著名的艺术家。

confuse.diff: artist 意为艺术家；article 意为文章或物品。

examples.src: This book belongs to my sister.
examples.dst: 这本书是我姐姐的。

examples.src: Where do these cups belong?
examples.dst: 这些杯子该放在哪儿？

examples.src: I feel that I belong here.
examples.dst: 我觉得我属于这里。

confuse.diff: belong 是动词，意为属于；belongings 是名词，意为随身物品。

examples.src: This house belongs to my grandparents.
examples.dst: 这座房子属于我的祖父母。

examples.src: Which club do you belong to?
examples.dst: 你属于哪个俱乐部？

examples.src: The island belongs to Australia.
examples.dst: 这座岛属于澳大利亚。

examples.src: He helped me, and I cooked dinner for him in return.
examples.dst: 他帮了我，我做晚饭作为回报。

examples.src: She expects nothing in return.
examples.dst: 她不期望任何回报。

examples.src: The king gave the czar a gift, and received soldiers in return.
examples.dst: 国王送给沙皇一件礼物，作为交换得到了士兵。

confuse.diff: in return 意为作为回报；in turn 意为依次、轮流。

examples.src: The Czar ruled Russia for many years.
examples.dst: 沙皇统治俄国多年。

examples.src: The Czar's palace was full of treasures.
examples.dst: 沙皇的宫殿里满是珍宝。

examples.src: The last Czar of Russia was Nicholas II.
examples.dst: 俄国最后一位沙皇是尼古拉二世。

examples.src: The troops marched into the city.
examples.dst: 军队开进了这座城市。

examples.src: Thousands of troops were sent to the border.
examples.dst: 数千名士兵被派往边境。

examples.src: A troop of children ran into the playground.
examples.dst: 一群孩子跑进了操场。

confuse.diff: troop 指军队；troupe 指剧团、演出团。

examples.src: Please wait at the reception desk.
examples.dst: 请在接待处等候。

examples.src: The mayor held a reception for the guests.
examples.dst: 市长为客人举行了招待会。

examples.src: The film got a warm reception from the audience.
examples.dst: 这部电影受到观众的热烈欢迎。

confuse.diff: reception 意为接待；receipt 意为收据。

examples.src: The two countries were at war for five years.
examples.dst: 这两个国家交战了五年。

examples.src: When the country is at war, people suffer.
examples.dst: 国家处于战争状态时，人民受苦。

examples.src: They were at war with their neighbor.
examples.dst: 他们与邻国处于交战状态。

confuse.diff: at war 意为处于战争状态；at peace 意为处于和平状态。

examples.src: Please remove your shoes before entering.
examples.dst: 进门前请脱鞋。

examples.src: He removed the stain from his shirt.
examples.dst: 他去掉了衬衫上的污渍。

examples.src: The soldiers removed the treasure from the palace.
examples.dst: 士兵们把珍宝从宫殿里搬走了。

confuse.diff: remove 意为移除；remote 意为遥远的。

examples.src: It took less than an hour to get there.
examples.dst: 到那里用了不到一个小时。

examples.src: She earns less than her brother.
examples.dst: 她挣得比她哥哥少。

examples.src: Less than half of the students passed the test.
examples.dst: 不到一半的学生通过了考试。

confuse.diff: less than 意为少于；no less than 意为多达、不少于。

examples.src: There is a wooden bridge over the river.
examples.dst: 河上有一座木桥。

examples.src: He sat on a wooden chair.
examples.dst: 他坐在一把木椅上。

examples.src: The old wooden house was full of memories.
examples.dst: 那座老木屋充满了回忆。

confuse.diff: wooden 是形容词，意为木制的；wood 是名词，意为木头、树林。

examples.src: I have no doubt that she will win.
examples.dst: 我毫不怀疑她会获胜。

examples.src: He doubted whether the story was true.
examples.dst: 他怀疑这个故事是否属实。

examples.src: There is some doubt about the date of the meeting.
examples.dst: 会议的日期还有些疑问。

confuse.diff: doubt 是名词或动词，意为怀疑；doubtful 是形容词，意为可疑的。

means: 柯尼斯堡（今俄罗斯加里宁格勒）

examples.src: Konigsberg was a famous city in East Prussia.
examples.dst: 柯尼斯堡是东普鲁士的一座名城。

examples.src: The Amber Room was moved to Konigsberg during the war.
examples.dst: 战争期间琥珀屋被转移到了柯尼斯堡。

examples.src: Konigsberg is now called Kaliningrad.
examples.dst: 柯尼斯堡现在叫加里宁格勒。

examples.src: The Baltic Sea lies in northern Europe.
examples.dst: 波罗的海位于北欧。

examples.src: Many ships crossed the Baltic Sea during the war.
examples.dst: 战争期间许多船只穿越波罗的海。

examples.src: Some people believe the treasure sank in the Baltic Sea.
examples.dst: 有些人相信那批珍宝沉在了波罗的海。

examples.src: The disappearance of the painting is still a mystery.
examples.dst: 那幅画的失踪至今仍是个谜。

examples.src: She loves reading mystery novels.
examples.dst: 她喜欢读推理小说。

examples.src: Scientists are trying to solve the mystery of the universe.
examples.dst: 科学家们正试图解开宇宙之谜。

confuse.diff: mystery 意为谜；history 意为历史。

examples.src: He is a former president of the club.
examples.dst: 他是俱乐部的前任主席。

examples.src: This building was a former prison.
examples.dst: 这座建筑以前是一座监狱。

examples.src: Of the two plans, I prefer the former.
examples.dst: 在这两个计划中，我更喜欢前者。

confuse.diff: former 意为以前的；farmer 意为农民。

examples.src: This old vase is worth a lot of money.
examples.dst: 这只旧花瓶很值钱。

examples.src: The museum is worth visiting.
examples.dst: 这座博物馆值得参观。

examples.src: She proved her worth in the competition.
examples.dst: 她在比赛中证明了自己的价值。

confuse.diff: worth 后接金额或动名词；worthy 常与 of 搭配，意为值得的。

examples.src: They plan to rebuild the old bridge.
examples.dst: 他们计划重建那座旧桥。

examples.src: The city was rebuilt after the war.
examples.dst: 战后这座城市得到了重建。

examples.src: It took years to rebuild their lives.
examples.dst: 他们花了数年时间重建生活。

confuse.diff: rebuild 意为重建；rebuke 意为责备。

examples.src: We tried some local food in the village.
examples.dst: 我们在村里尝了一些当地的食物。

examples.src: The local people are very friendly.
examples.dst: 当地人非常友好。

examples.src: She works for a local newspaper.
examples.dst: 她为一家地方报纸工作。

confuse.diff: local 是形容词，意为当地的；locate 是动词，意为找到位置。

examples.src: The two villages are five miles apart.
examples.dst: 这两个村庄相距五英里。

examples.src: The old toy fell apart.
examples.dst: 那个旧玩具散架了。

examples.src: They have lived apart for years.
examples.dst: 他们已分开生活多年。

confuse.diff: apart 意为分开地；a part 意为一部分。

examples.src: He took the clock apart to see how it worked.
examples.dst: 他把钟拆开看它是怎么运转的。

examples.src: Can you take this machine apart?
examples.dst: 你能把这台机器拆开吗？

examples.src: The workers took the old wooden house apart.
examples.dst: 工人们把那座旧木屋拆掉了。

confuse.diff: take apart 意为拆开；take part 意为参加。

examples.src: The painting hangs on the wall of the living room.
examples.dst: 这幅画挂在客厅的墙上。

examples.src: She is good at Chinese painting.
examples.dst: 她擅长中国画。

examples.src: The museum has a collection of famous paintings.
examples.dst: 这家博物馆收藏有著名的画作。

confuse.diff: painting 指画作；painter 指画家或油漆工。

examples.src: The king lived in a huge castle.
examples.dst: 国王住在一座巨大的城堡里。

examples.src: We visited an old castle on the hill.
examples.dst: 我们参观了山上的一座古堡。

examples.src: The children built a sand castle on the beach.
examples.dst: 孩子们在海滩上堆了一座沙堡。

confuse.diff: castle 指带防御功能的城堡；palace 指宫殿。

means: 温莎城堡（英国王室住所）

examples.src: Windsor Castle is one of the royal residences in Britain.
examples.dst: 温莎城堡是英国王室的住所之一。

examples.src: Thousands of tourists visit Windsor Castle each year.
examples.dst: 每年有数千名游客参观温莎城堡。

examples.src: The queen often stayed at Windsor Castle at weekends.
examples.dst: 女王周末常住在温莎城堡。

examples.src: The trial lasted for three days.
examples.dst: 审判持续了三天。

examples.src: The new medicine is still on trial.
examples.dst: 这种新药仍在试验中。

examples.src: You can have a free trial of the software for a week.
examples.dst: 你可以免费试用这款软件一周。

confuse.diff: trial 意为审判、试验；trail 意为小径、痕迹。

examples.src: An eyewitness described the accident to the police.
examples.dst: 一名目击者向警方描述了事故经过。

examples.src: She was the only eyewitness of the crime.
examples.dst: 她是这起罪案唯一的目击者。

examples.src: The eyewitness report helped solve the case.
examples.dst: 目击者的陈述帮助破了案。

confuse.diff: eyewitness 强调亲眼所见的人；witness 还可指作证或见证。

examples.src: There is no evidence that he stole the money.
examples.dst: 没有证据表明他偷了钱。

examples.src: The police are looking for more evidence.
examples.dst: 警方正在寻找更多证据。

examples.src: Scientists found evidence of life on the island.
examples.dst: 科学家在岛上发现了生命存在的迹象。

confuse.diff: evidence 是名词，意为证据；evident 是形容词，意为明显的。

examples.src: The bomb exploded in the middle of the night.
examples.dst: 炸弹在半夜爆炸了。

examples.src: He exploded with anger when he heard the news.
examples.dst: 他听到消息后勃然大怒。

examples.src: The city's population has exploded in recent years.
examples.dst: 近年来这座城市的人口激增。

confuse.diff: explode 意为爆炸；explore 意为探索。

examples.src: Meet me at the main entrance of the museum.
examples.dst: 在博物馆正门口和我碰面。

examples.src: The entrance to the cave was hidden by bushes.
examples.dst: 洞口被灌木丛遮住了。

examples.src: He passed the entrance exam to the university.
examples.dst: 他通过了这所大学的入学考试。

confuse.diff: entrance 多指入口处；entry 多指进入的行为或条目。

examples.src: The sailor has traveled around the world.
examples.dst: 这位水手环游过世界。

examples.src: Many sailors lost their lives in the storm.
examples.dst: 许多水手在暴风雨中丧生。

examples.src: My grandfather was a sailor in the navy.
examples.dst: 我祖父曾是海军水手。

confuse.diff: sailor 是水手；sail 意为航行或帆。

examples.src: The ship sank in the Baltic Sea.
examples.dst: 那艘船沉没在波罗的海。

examples.src: A stone sinks in water.
examples.dst: 石头在水中会下沉。

examples.src: She washed the dishes in the kitchen sink.
examples.dst: 她在厨房水槽里洗碗。

confuse.diff: sink 意为下沉；think 意为思考。

examples.src: The maid cleaned the rooms every morning.
examples.dst: 女仆每天早晨打扫房间。

examples.src: They hired a maid to help with housework.
examples.dst: 他们雇了一名女佣帮忙做家务。

examples.src: The maid brought tea to the guests.
examples.dst: 女仆给客人们端来了茶。

confuse.diff: maid 意为女仆；made 是 make 的过去式和过去分词。

examples.src: The teacher thinks highly of her.
examples.dst: 老师对她评价很高。

examples.src: Everyone thinks highly of his honesty.
examples.dst: 大家都很看重他的诚实。

examples.src: I think highly of this book.
examples.dst: 我对这本书评价很高。

confuse.diff: think highly of 意为高度评价；think of 意为想到、考虑。

examples.src: We had an informal meeting after lunch.
examples.dst: 午饭后我们开了个非正式会议。

examples.src: You can wear informal clothes to the party.
examples.dst: 你可以穿便装去参加聚会。

examples.src: This word is mostly used in informal English.
examples.dst: 这个词多用于非正式英语中。

confuse.diff: informal 意为非正式的；information 意为信息。

examples.src: The students held a debate on school uniforms.
examples.dst: 学生们就校服问题举行了一场辩论。

examples.src: They debated whether to build a new library.
examples.dst: 他们讨论是否要建一座新图书馆。

examples.src: There was a heated debate about the plan.
examples.dst: 关于这个计划有过一场激烈的争论。

confuse.diff: debate 意为辩论；debt 意为债务。

examples.src: The ancient Greeks held the first Olympic Games.
examples.dst: 古希腊人举办了第一届奥运会。

examples.src: We visited an ancient temple in the mountains.
examples.dst: 我们参观了山里的一座古庙。

examples.src: Ancient Egypt is famous for its pyramids.
examples.dst: 古埃及以金字塔闻名。

confuse.diff: ancient 意为古代的；ancestor 意为祖先。

examples.src: Many athletes compete in the Olympic Games.
examples.dst: 许多运动员参加奥运会比赛。

examples.src: The two companies compete for customers.
examples.dst: 这两家公司争夺客户。

examples.src: She competed against her classmate in the speech contest.
examples.dst: 她在演讲比赛中与同学竞争。

confuse.diff: compete 意为竞争；complete 意为完成或完整的。

examples.src: He is my strongest competitor in the race.
examples.dst: 他是我在这场比赛中最强的对手。

examples.src: More than a hundred competitors took part in the contest.
examples.dst: 一百多名选手参加了这次比赛。

examples.src: The company is watching its competitors closely.
examples.dst: 这家公司密切关注着自己的竞争对手。

confuse.diff: competitor 指人，意为竞争者；competition 指竞争或比赛。

examples.src: Many students took part in the school sports meeting.
examples.dst: 许多学生参加了学校运动会。

examples.src: I'd like to take part in the English speech contest.
examples.dst: 我想参加英语演讲比赛。

examples.src: Everyone should take part in protecting the environment.
examples.dst: 每个人都应该参与环境保护。

confuse.diff: take part in 指参加活动；join 指加入组织或团体。

examples.src: She won a gold medal in swimming.
examples.dst: 她在游泳比赛中赢得了金牌。

examples.src: The soldier received a medal for his bravery.
examples.dst: 这名士兵因英勇获得了一枚勋章。

examples.src: Our school team brought home three medals.
examples.dst: 我们学校的队伍带回了三枚奖牌。

confuse.diff: medal 意为奖牌；metal 意为金属。

examples.src: The five rings stand for five continents.
examples.dst: 五个环代表五大洲。

examples.src: What does WHO stand for?
examples.dst: WHO 代表什么？

examples.src: I will not stand for such rude behavior.
examples.dst: 我不能容忍这种粗鲁的行为。

confuse.diff: stand for 意为代表、支持；stand by 意为支持或袖手旁观。

examples.src: The panda is the mascot of the 2008 Beijing Olympics.
examples.dst: 熊猫是2008年北京奥运会的吉祥物之一。

examples.src: Each team has its own mascot.
examples.dst: 每支球队都有自己的吉祥物。

examples.src: The children took photos with the cute mascot.
examples.dst: 孩子们和可爱的吉祥物合影。

examples.src: The story is about a magical forest.
examples.dst: 这个故事讲的是一片神奇的森林。

examples.src: We had a magical evening by the lake.
examples.dst: 我们在湖边度过了一个奇妙的夜晚。

examples.src: The little girl found a magical stone.
examples.dst: 小女孩发现了一块有魔力的石头。

confuse.diff: magical 是形容词，意为神奇的；magic 是名词，意为魔法。

examples.src: She works as a volunteer at the hospital.
examples.dst: 她在医院做志愿者。

examples.src: Many students volunteered to clean the park.
examples.dst: 许多学生自愿去打扫公园。

examples.src: The Olympic Games need thousands of volunteers.
examples.dst: 奥运会需要成千上万名志愿者。

confuse.diff: volunteer 指志愿者或自愿做；voluntary 是形容词，意为自愿的。

examples.src: He returned to his homeland after thirty years.
examples.dst: 三十年后他回到了祖国。

examples.src: They were forced to leave their homeland.
examples.dst: 他们被迫离开了家园。

examples.src: Love for the homeland is deep in his heart.
examples.dst: 他心中怀着对祖国的深情。

confuse.diff: homeland 指祖国；hometown 指家乡城镇。

examples.src: You should take regular exercise.
examples.dst: 你应该经常锻炼。

examples.src: The bus runs at regular intervals.
examples.dst: 公共汽车每隔固定时间发一班。

examples.src: He is a regular visitor to the library.
examples.dst: 他是图书馆的常客。

confuse.diff: regular 是形容词，意为有规律的；regulate 是动词，意为管理、调节。

examples.src: Trust is the basis of friendship.
examples.dst: 信任是友谊的基础。

examples.src: They meet on a regular basis.
examples.dst: 他们定期见面。

examples.src: The decision has no basis in fact.
examples.dst: 这个决定没有事实依据。

confuse.diff: basis 多指抽象的基础或依据；base 多指具体的底部或基地。

examples.src: The athlete trains for six hours every day.
examples.dst: 这位运动员每天训练六个小时。

examples.src: Athletes from many countries came to the games.
examples.dst: 来自许多国家的运动员参加了运动会。

examples.src: She dreams of becoming a professional athlete.
examples.dst: 她梦想成为一名职业运动员。

confuse.diff: athlete 是名词，意为运动员；athletic 是形容词，意为运动的。

examples.src: He admitted that he had made a mistake.
examples.dst: 他承认自己犯了错误。

examples.src: The university admitted three hundred new students.
examples.dst: 这所大学录取了三百名新生。

examples.src: Children under twelve are not admitted.
examples.dst: 十二岁以下的儿童不得入内。

confuse.diff: admit 指承认或准许进入；permit 指允许做某事。

examples.src: In ancient times, slaves had no freedom.
examples.dst: 古时候奴隶没有自由。

examples.src: He is a slave to his work.
examples.dst: 他是工作的奴隶。

examples.src: She slaved away in the kitchen all day.
examples.dst: 她一整天在厨房里拼命干活。

confuse.diff: slave 意为奴隶；slap 意为拍打。

examples.src: Nowadays most people have smartphones.
examples.dst: 如今大多数人都有智能手机。

examples.src: Nowadays, young people prefer to shop online.
examples.dst: 如今年轻人更喜欢网上购物。

examples.src: Life is much easier nowadays than it used to be.
examples.dst: 现在的生活比过去容易多了。

confuse.diff: nowadays 意为如今；nowhere 意为无处。

examples.src: She has practiced gymnastics since she was five.
examples.dst: 她从五岁起就练体操。

examples.src: Gymnastics requires strength and balance.
examples.dst: 体操需要力量和平衡能力。

examples.src: He won a gold medal in gymnastics.
examples.dst: 他在体操项目中赢得了金牌。

confuse.diff: gymnastics 是体操运动；gymnasium 是体育馆。

examples.src: Athletics includes running, jumping and throwing.
examples.dst: 田径包括跑、跳和投掷项目。

examples.src: He is the best in the school athletics team.
examples.dst: 他是学校田径队里最优秀的。

examples.src: The athletics meeting will be held next week.
examples.dst: 田径运动会将于下周举行。

confuse.diff: athletics 是田径运动；athlete 是运动员。

examples.src: The opening ceremony was held in the National Stadium.
examples.dst: 开幕式在国家体育场举行。

examples.src: Thousands of fans filled the stadium.
examples.dst: 成千上万的球迷挤满了体育场。

examples.src: The new stadium can hold eighty thousand people.
examples.dst: 这座新体育场能容纳八万人。

confuse.diff: stadium 是露天或大型体育场；gymnasium 是室内体育馆。

examples.src: The basketball game will be held in the gymnasium.
examples.dst: 篮球赛将在体育馆举行。

examples.src: Our school has a large gymnasium.
examples.dst: 我们学校有一座大体育馆。

examples.src: They practice volleyball in the gymnasium after class.
examples.dst: 他们课后在体育馆练排球。

confuse.diff: gymnasium 是体育馆；gymnastics 是体操。

examples.src: He goes to the gym three times a week.
examples.dst: 他每周去三次健身房。

examples.src: We have gym class on Tuesday afternoon.
examples.dst: 我们周二下午有体育课。

examples.src: She joined a gym to get fit.
examples.dst: 她加入了一家健身房来保持健康。

confuse.diff: gym 意为健身房；jam 意为果酱或堵塞。

examples.src: I like music, and I like painting as well.
examples.dst: 我喜欢音乐，也喜欢绘画。

examples.src: She speaks English and French as well.
examples.dst: 她会说英语，也会说法语。

examples.src: Can I come along as well?
examples.dst: 我也可以一起去吗？

confuse.diff: as well 放句末，意为也；as well as 连接并列成分，意为和、除了。

examples.src: China hosted the 2008 Olympic Games.
examples.dst: 中国举办了2008年奥运会。

examples.src: The host welcomed every guest at the door.
examples.dst: 主人在门口欢迎每一位客人。

examples.src: She is the host of a popular TV show.
examples.dst: 她是一档热门电视节目的主持人。

confuse.diff: host 泛指主人，也可指男主人；hostess 指女主人。

examples.src: Taking care of the pets is my responsibility.
examples.dst: 照顾宠物是我的责任。

examples.src: Parents have a responsibility to educate their children.
examples.dst: 父母有责任教育孩子。

examples.src: She took responsibility for the mistake.
examples.dst: 她为这个错误承担了责任。

confuse.diff: responsibility 是名词，意为责任；responsible 是形容词，意为负责的。

examples.src: Olive oil is good for your health.
examples.dst: 橄榄油对健康有益。

examples.src: An olive branch is a symbol of peace.
examples.dst: 橄榄枝是和平的象征。

examples.src: She put some olives on the pizza.
examples.dst: 她在比萨上放了一些橄榄。

confuse.diff: olive 是橄榄；Oliver 是人名。

examples.src: The winner wore an olive wreath on his head.
examples.dst: 获胜者头上戴着橄榄花环。

examples.src: They laid a wreath at the memorial.
examples.dst: 他们在纪念碑前献上了花圈。

examples.src: A Christmas wreath hung on the front door.
examples.dst: 前门上挂着一个圣诞花环。

confuse.diff: wreath 意为花环；wreck 意为残骸或毁坏。

examples.src: Machines cannot replace teachers completely.
examples.dst: 机器不能完全取代教师。

examples.src: I need to replace the old battery.
examples.dst: 我需要更换旧电池。

examples.src: He replaced the book on the shelf.
examples.dst: 他把书放回了书架上。

confuse.diff: replace 意为取代；reply 意为回复。

examples.src: The Olympic motto is "Faster, Higher, Stronger".
examples.dst: 奥林匹克格言是“更快、更高、更强”。

examples.src: Our school motto is "Study hard and be kind".
examples.dst: 我们的校训是“勤学向善”。

examples.src: "Never give up" is my motto.
examples.dst: “永不放弃”是我的座右铭。

confuse.diff: motto 意为座右铭；moth 意为飞蛾。

examples.src: The runner was swift and strong.
examples.dst: 这位跑步者敏捷而有力。

examples.src: The company made a swift response to the problem.
examples.dst: 公司对这个问题做出了迅速反应。

examples.src: A swift flew across the evening sky.
examples.dst: 一只雨燕飞过傍晚的天空。

confuse.diff: swift 意为迅速的；sweet 意为甜的。

examples.src: There is a strong similarity between the two languages.
examples.dst: 这两种语言之间有很强的相似性。

examples.src: The twins show a similarity in their habits.
examples.dst: 这对双胞胎在习惯上有相似之处。

examples.src: I can see little similarity between them.
examples.dst: 我看不出他们有多少相似之处。

confuse.diff: similarity 是名词，意为相似；similar 是形容词，意为相似的。

examples.src: Athens is the capital of Greece.
examples.dst: 雅典是希腊的首都。

examples.src: The first modern Olympic Games were held in Athens in 1896.
examples.dst: 第一届现代奥运会于1896年在雅典举行。

examples.src: We visited the ancient ruins in Athens.
examples.dst: 我们参观了雅典的古代遗址。

examples.src: The hotel charges eighty dollars a night.
examples.dst: 这家旅馆每晚收费八十美元。

examples.src: I need to charge my phone.
examples.dst: 我需要给手机充电。

examples.src: He was charged with stealing.
examples.dst: 他被指控偷窃。

confuse.diff: charge 意为收费、充电；change 意为改变、零钱。

examples.src: Who is in charge of this project?
examples.dst: 谁负责这个项目？

examples.src: The teacher left the monitor in charge of the class.
examples.dst: 老师让班长负责管理班级。

examples.src: She is in charge of the school library.
examples.dst: 她负责学校图书馆。

confuse.diff: in charge 单独使用时意为主管；in charge of 后接所管理的对象。

examples.src: Regular exercise is good for your physical health.
examples.dst: 经常锻炼有益于身体健康。

examples.src: The job requires a lot of physical strength.
examples.dst: 这份工作需要很大的体力。

examples.src: We have physical education twice a week.
examples.dst: 我们每周上两次体育课。

confuse.diff: physical 意为身体的；physician 意为内科医生。

examples.src: It's a fine day for a picnic.
examples.dst: 今天是野餐的好天气。

examples.src: He had to pay a fine for parking here.
examples.dst: 他因在这里停车而被罚款。

examples.src: I'm fine, thank you.
examples.dst: 我很好，谢谢。

confuse.diff: fine 意为好的、罚款；find 意为找到。

examples.src: There is a movie poster on the wall.
examples.dst: 墙上有一张电影海报。

examples.src: We made posters for the school concert.
examples.dst: 我们为学校音乐会制作了海报。

examples.src: The poster says the sale starts tomorrow.
examples.dst: 海报上说促销明天开始。

confuse.diff: poster 是海报或招贴画；postage 是邮资。

examples.src: The company advertises its products on TV.
examples.dst: 这家公司在电视上为产品做广告。

examples.src: They advertised the job in the newspaper.
examples.dst: 他们在报纸上刊登了招聘广告。

examples.src: The shop advertises a big sale this weekend.
examples.dst: 这家商店宣传本周末大减价。

confuse.diff: advertise 是动词，意为做广告；advertisement 是名词，意为广告。

examples.src: The princess lived in a tall tower.
examples.dst: 公主住在一座高塔里。

examples.src: The little girl dressed up as a princess.
examples.dst: 小女孩打扮成了公主。

examples.src: The prince fell in love with the princess.
examples.dst: 王子爱上了公主。

confuse.diff: princess 是公主；prince 是王子。

examples.src: The team won glory for the school.
examples.dst: 这支队伍为学校赢得了荣誉。

examples.src: The soldiers returned home covered in glory.
examples.dst: 士兵们载誉而归。

examples.src: We admired the glory of the sunrise.
examples.dst: 我们赞叹日出的壮丽。

confuse.diff: glory 意为荣誉；gloomy 意为阴暗的、忧郁的。

examples.src: This coat was a real bargain.
examples.dst: 这件外套真是物美价廉。

examples.src: She bargained with the seller for a lower price.
examples.dst: 她和卖家讨价还价，想把价格压低。

examples.src: They made a bargain to share the cost.
examples.dst: 他们达成协议，共同分担费用。

examples.src: The prince married a girl from a small village.
examples.dst: 王子娶了一位来自小村庄的女孩。

examples.src: The young prince was brave and kind.
examples.dst: 年轻的王子勇敢而善良。

examples.src: Prince William visited our city last year.
examples.dst: 威廉王子去年访问了我们的城市。

confuse.diff: prince 是王子；princess 是公主。

examples.src: The situation seemed hopeless.
examples.dst: 局势看起来毫无希望。

examples.src: He felt hopeless after failing the exam.
examples.dst: 考试失败后他感到绝望。

examples.src: I'm hopeless at cooking.
examples.dst: 我做饭糟糕透了。

confuse.diff: hopeless 意为没有希望的；helpless 意为无助的。

examples.src: It was foolish of me to trust him.
examples.dst: 我相信他真是愚蠢。

examples.src: Don't do anything foolish.
examples.dst: 不要做傻事。

examples.src: She felt foolish when she made the mistake in public.
examples.dst: 她在众人面前出错时觉得自己很傻。

confuse.diff: foolish 是形容词，意为愚蠢的；fool 是名词，意为傻瓜。

examples.src: Athena was the goddess of wisdom in Greek myth.
examples.dst: 雅典娜是希腊神话中的智慧女神。

examples.src: The ancient Greeks built a temple for the goddess.
examples.dst: 古希腊人为这位女神建了一座神庙。

examples.src: She is like a goddess to her fans.
examples.dst: 在粉丝眼中她就像女神一样。

confuse.diff: goddess 是女神；god 是神或男神。

examples.src: I have a pain in my back.
examples.dst: 我背疼。

examples.src: He cried out in pain.
examples.dst: 他痛得大叫起来。

examples.src: The loss of his friend caused him great pain.
examples.dst: 失去朋友给他带来了巨大的痛苦。

confuse.diff: pain 意为疼痛；pane 意为窗玻璃。

examples.src: The runners crossed the finish line one after another.
examples.dst: 跑步者们一个接一个地冲过终点线。

examples.src: Problems came one after another.
examples.dst: 问题接二连三地出现。

examples.src: The guests arrived one after another.
examples.dst: 客人们陆续到达。

confuse.diff: one after another 指多者依次；one after the other 多指两者先后。

examples.src: You deserve a good rest after the hard work.
examples.dst: 辛苦工作之后你应该好好休息。

examples.src: She deserves the prize.
examples.dst: 她理应获奖。

examples.src: This problem deserves more attention.
examples.dst: 这个问题值得更多关注。

confuse.diff: deserve 意为应得；reserve 意为预订、保留。

examples.src: The striker scored two goals in the match.
examples.dst: 这名前锋在比赛中进了两个球。

examples.src: He is the best striker in our school team.
examples.dst: 他是我们校队里最好的前锋。

examples.src: The strikers demanded higher pay.
examples.dst: 罢工者要求提高工资。

confuse.diff: striker 意为前锋；stricter 意为更严格的。

examples.src: The abacus is an ancient Chinese calculating tool.
examples.dst: 算盘是中国古代的计算工具。

examples.src: My grandfather can use an abacus very quickly.
examples.dst: 我祖父用算盘非常快。

examples.src: Children in the past learned to count with an abacus.
examples.dst: 过去的孩子们用算盘学习计算。

confuse.diff: abacus 是算盘；calculator 是计算器。

examples.src: You can use a calculator in the math exam.
examples.dst: 数学考试中你可以使用计算器。

examples.src: My phone has a built-in calculator.
examples.dst: 我的手机有内置计算器。

examples.src: He pressed the buttons on the calculator.
examples.dst: 他按了计算器上的按键。

confuse.diff: calculator 是计算器；calendar 是日历。

examples.src: I do my homework on my PC.
examples.dst: 我在个人电脑上做作业。

examples.src: Most families own a PC nowadays.
examples.dst: 如今大多数家庭都有个人电脑。

examples.src: The PC was invented in the 1970s.
examples.dst: 个人电脑发明于20世纪70年代。

confuse.diff: PC 泛指个人电脑，常指台式机；laptop 是便携式笔记本电脑。

examples.src: She carries her laptop to school every day.
examples.dst: 她每天带着笔记本电脑去学校。

examples.src: I wrote the report on my laptop.
examples.dst: 我在笔记本电脑上写了报告。

examples.src: The laptop battery lasts about ten hours.
examples.dst: 这台笔记本电脑的电池能用大约十个小时。

confuse.diff: laptop 是便携式笔记本电脑；desktop 是台式电脑。

examples.src: He kept his schedule in a PDA.
examples.dst: 他把日程安排存在掌上电脑里。

examples.src: A PDA was a popular device before smartphones.
examples.dst: 在智能手机出现之前，掌上电脑是一种流行的设备。

examples.src: She used her PDA to check her email.
examples.dst: 她用掌上电脑查看电子邮件。

confuse.diff: PDA 是掌上电脑；PC 是个人电脑。

examples.src: She has a strong analytical mind.
examples.dst: 她有很强的分析头脑。

examples.src: The scientist took an analytical approach to the problem.
examples.dst: 这位科学家用分析的方法处理这个问题。

examples.src: Analytical skills are important for this job.
examples.dst: 分析能力对这份工作很重要。

confuse.diff: analytical 是形容词，意为分析的；analysis 是名词，意为分析。

examples.src: Please calculate the total cost of the trip.
examples.dst: 请算一下这次旅行的总费用。

examples.src: The computer can calculate very quickly.
examples.dst: 计算机能够非常快速地进行计算。

examples.src: Scientists calculated the distance between the two stars.
examples.dst: 科学家们计算出了这两颗星之间的距离。

confuse.diff: calculate 意为计算；calendar 意为日历。

examples.src: Music is a universal language.
examples.dst: 音乐是一种通用的语言。

examples.src: Smiling has a universal meaning.
examples.dst: 微笑具有普遍的含义。

examples.src: They are looking for a universal solution.
examples.dst: 他们在寻找一种通用的解决办法。

confuse.diff: universal 意为普遍的；university 意为大学。

examples.src: The new system simplifies the process.
examples.dst: 新系统简化了流程。

examples.src: Can you simplify the instructions?
examples.dst: 你能把说明简化一下吗？

examples.src: Technology has simplified our daily lives.
examples.dst: 科技简化了我们的日常生活。

confuse.diff: simplify 是动词，意为简化；simple 是形容词，意为简单的。

examples.src: The sum of three and four is seven.
examples.dst: 三加四的和是七。

examples.src: He paid a large sum of money for the house.
examples.dst: 他为这所房子付了一大笔钱。

examples.src: Let me sum up the main points.
examples.dst: 让我总结一下要点。

confuse.diff: sum 意为总和；some 意为一些。

examples.src: The operator put me through to the manager.
examples.dst: 接线员把我的电话转给了经理。

examples.src: He works as a machine operator in a factory.
examples.dst: 他在工厂做机器操作员。

examples.src: The plus sign is an operator in mathematics.
examples.dst: 加号是数学中的一个运算符。

confuse.diff: operator 指操作者；operation 指操作或手术。

examples.src: His argument is clear and logical.
examples.dst: 他的论点清晰而有逻辑。

examples.src: It is logical to save money for the future.
examples.dst: 为将来存钱是合理的。

examples.src: She has a logical mind.
examples.dst: 她头脑有逻辑性。

confuse.diff: logical 是形容词，意为合乎逻辑的；logic 是名词，意为逻辑。

examples.src: He explained his idea logically.
examples.dst: 他有逻辑地解释了自己的想法。

examples.src: Think logically before you make a decision.
examples.dst: 做决定之前要有逻辑地思考。

examples.src: Logically, the answer must be correct.
examples.dst: 从逻辑上讲，这个答案一定是正确的。

confuse.diff: logically 是副词；logical 是形容词。

examples.src: Modern technology has changed the way we live.
examples.dst: 现代科技改变了我们的生活方式。

examples.src: The company invests a lot in new technology.
examples.dst: 这家公司在新技术上投入很大。

examples.src: He studies information technology at university.
examples.dst: 他在大学里学习信息技术。

confuse.diff: technology 指科学技术；technique 指技巧、方法。

examples.src: We live in an age of rapid technological change.
examples.dst: 我们生活在科技飞速变化的时代。

examples.src: The country has made great technological progress.
examples.dst: 这个国家取得了巨大的技术进步。

examples.src: Technological development brings both benefits and problems.
examples.dst: 科技发展既带来益处也带来问题。

confuse.diff: technological 是形容词；technology 是名词。

examples.src: The Industrial Revolution began in Britain.
examples.dst: 工业革命始于英国。

examples.src: The Internet caused a revolution in communication.
examples.dst: 互联网引起了通信领域的革命。

examples.src: The 1911 Revolution ended the Qing Dynasty.
examples.dst: 1911年的革命结束了清朝。

confuse.diff: revolution 指剧烈变革；evolution 指渐进的演变或进化。

examples.src: The lake is artificial, not natural.
examples.dst: 这个湖是人工湖，不是天然的。

examples.src: This juice contains no artificial colors.
examples.dst: 这种果汁不含人工色素。

examples.src: She greeted us with an artificial smile.
examples.dst: 她带着虚假的笑容迎接我们。

confuse.diff: artificial 意为人造的；artistic 意为艺术的。

examples.src: Dolphins are animals of high intelligence.
examples.dst: 海豚是智力很高的动物。

examples.src: Artificial intelligence is changing our world.
examples.dst: 人工智能正在改变我们的世界。

examples.src: The agency collects intelligence about the enemy.
examples.dst: 该机构搜集有关敌方的情报。

confuse.diff: intelligence 是名词，意为智力；intelligent 是形容词，意为聪明的。

examples.src: She is an intelligent and hard-working student.
examples.dst: 她是一个聪明又勤奋的学生。

examples.src: Dogs are intelligent animals.
examples.dst: 狗是聪明的动物。

examples.src: Intelligent robots can learn from experience.
examples.dst: 智能机器人能从经验中学习。

confuse.diff: intelligent 意为聪明的；intelligible 意为可理解的。

examples.src: We need to solve this problem as soon as possible.
examples.dst: 我们需要尽快解决这个问题。

examples.src: He solved the math question in five minutes.
examples.dst: 他用五分钟解出了这道数学题。

examples.src: The police finally solved the case.
examples.dst: 警方最终破了这个案子。

confuse.diff: solve 是动词，意为解决；solution 是名词，意为解决办法。

examples.src: He has a talent for mathematical thinking.
examples.dst: 他有数学思维的天赋。

examples.src: The teacher solved a mathematical problem on the board.
examples.dst: 老师在黑板上解了一道数学题。

examples.src: Mathematical skills are useful in science.
examples.dst: 数学能力在科学中很有用。

confuse.diff: mathematical 是形容词；mathematics 是名词，意为数学。

examples.src: From then on, he studied much harder.
examples.dst: 从那时起，他学习努力多了。

examples.src: From now on, I will get up early every day.
examples.dst: 从现在起，我每天都早起。

examples.src: From that day on, they became good friends.
examples.dst: 从那天起，他们成了好朋友。

examples.src: His dream finally became a reality.
examples.dst: 他的梦想终于成为现实。

examples.src: You have to face reality.
examples.dst: 你必须面对现实。

examples.src: In reality, the work was much harder than it looked.
examples.dst: 实际上，这项工作比看上去难得多。

confuse.diff: reality 意为现实；realty 意为不动产。

examples.src: She works as a fashion designer in Paris.
examples.dst: 她在巴黎做服装设计师。

examples.src: The designer showed us his new plan.
examples.dst: 设计师向我们展示了他的新方案。

examples.src: My brother wants to be a game designer.
examples.dst: 我哥哥想成为一名游戏设计师。

confuse.diff: designer 是设计师；design 是设计。

examples.src: This is my personal opinion.
examples.dst: 这是我个人的看法。

examples.src: Please don't ask about my personal life.
examples.dst: 请不要询问我的私人生活。

examples.src: The manager paid a personal visit to the customer.
examples.dst: 经理亲自拜访了这位顾客。

confuse.diff: personal 意为个人的；personnel 意为全体员工。

examples.src: Personally, I prefer tea to coffee.
examples.dst: 就我个人而言，我更喜欢茶而不是咖啡。

examples.src: The headmaster thanked each student personally.
examples.dst: 校长亲自感谢了每一位学生。

examples.src: I don't know him personally.
examples.dst: 我与他并不熟识。

confuse.diff: personally 是副词；personal 是形容词。

examples.src: He squeezed some toothpaste out of the tube.
examples.dst: 他从牙膏管里挤出一些牙膏。

examples.src: Early computers used vacuum tubes.
examples.dst: 早期的计算机使用电子管。

examples.src: We took the tube to the museum in London.
examples.dst: 我们乘伦敦地铁去博物馆。

confuse.diff: tube 意为管子；tub 意为桶、浴缸。

examples.src: The transistor replaced the vacuum tube in computers.
examples.dst: 晶体管在计算机中取代了电子管。

examples.src: Millions of transistors are packed on a single chip.
examples.dst: 数以百万计的晶体管集成在一块芯片上。

examples.src: My grandfather still listens to an old transistor radio.
examples.dst: 我祖父仍然听一台老式晶体管收音机。

confuse.diff: transistor 是晶体管；transmitter 是发射器。

examples.src: The computer chip is smaller than a coin.
examples.dst: 这块计算机芯片比硬币还小。

examples.src: There is a chip on the edge of the cup.
examples.dst: 杯子边缘有一处缺口。

examples.src: We ordered fish and chips for lunch.
examples.dst: 我们午饭点了炸鱼和薯条。

confuse.diff: chip 意为芯片、碎片；ship 意为船。

examples.src: He worked hard, and as a result, he passed the exam.
examples.dst: 他努力学习，因此通过了考试。

examples.src: It rained heavily, and as a result, the match was canceled.
examples.dst: 雨下得很大，结果比赛被取消了。

examples.src: As a result of the accident, the road was closed.
examples.dst: 由于这起事故，道路被封闭了。

confuse.diff: as a result 单独使用，意为结果；as a result of 后接原因，意为由于。

examples.src: The total cost of the trip was five hundred dollars.
examples.dst: 这次旅行的总费用是五百美元。

examples.src: A total of forty students joined the club.
examples.dst: 共有四十名学生加入了这个俱乐部。

examples.src: The bill totals two hundred yuan.
examples.dst: 账单总计两百元。

confuse.diff: total 是形容词或名词；totally 是副词，意为完全地。

examples.src: I totally agree with you.
examples.dst: 我完全同意你的看法。

examples.src: The house was totally destroyed by the fire.
examples.dst: 这所房子被大火彻底烧毁了。

examples.src: That's a totally different question.
examples.dst: 那是个完全不同的问题。

confuse.diff: totally 是副词；total 是形容词或名词。

examples.src: The box was so heavy that I couldn't lift it.
examples.dst: 这个箱子太重了，我搬不动。

examples.src: She was so tired that she fell asleep at once.
examples.dst: 她太累了，一下子就睡着了。

examples.src: It was so cold that the river froze.
examples.dst: 天气冷得河水都结冰了。

confuse.diff: so…that… 后接形容词或副词；such…that… 后接名词短语。

examples.src: The school computers are connected to a network.
examples.dst: 学校的电脑都连接到了一个网络。

examples.src: The city has a good railway network.
examples.dst: 这座城市有完善的铁路网。

examples.src: He built a network of friends in the industry.
examples.dst: 他在业内建立了朋友圈。

confuse.diff: network 指网络系统；net 指网或互联网的简称。

examples.src: A spider is spinning a web in the corner.
examples.dst: 一只蜘蛛正在墙角织网。

examples.src: I found the information on the web.
examples.dst: 我在网上找到了这些信息。

examples.src: The web of roads covers the whole area.
examples.dst: 公路网覆盖了整个地区。

confuse.diff: web 意为网；wed 意为结婚。

examples.src: I sent an application to the university.
examples.dst: 我向这所大学递交了申请。

examples.src: This phone has many useful applications.
examples.dst: 这部手机有很多实用的应用程序。

examples.src: The application of new technology improved production.
examples.dst: 新技术的应用提高了产量。

confuse.diff: application 是名词，意为申请、应用；apply 是动词，意为申请、应用。

examples.src: He works in the finance department of the company.
examples.dst: 他在公司的财务部门工作。

examples.src: She studies finance at university.
examples.dst: 她在大学里学习金融。

examples.src: The government financed the building of the bridge.
examples.dst: 政府为这座桥的修建提供了资金。

confuse.diff: finance 意为金融、财务；fine 意为好的或罚款。

examples.src: A mobile library visits our village every week.
examples.dst: 流动图书馆每周都来我们村。

examples.src: Please turn off your mobile in the cinema.
examples.dst: 在电影院里请关掉手机。

examples.src: Mobile payment is very popular in China.
examples.dst: 移动支付在中国非常普及。

confuse.diff: mobile 意为可移动的；motive 意为动机。

examples.src: The rocket was launched into space yesterday.
examples.dst: 火箭昨天被发射到太空。

examples.src: Prices have rocketed in recent months.
examples.dst: 近几个月物价飞涨。

examples.src: The children watched the rockets light up the sky.
examples.dst: 孩子们观看烟花照亮夜空。

confuse.diff: rocket 意为火箭；pocket 意为口袋。

examples.src: They want to explore the deep sea.
examples.dst: 他们想探索深海。

examples.src: We explored the old town on foot.
examples.dst: 我们步行游览了这座古镇。

examples.src: Scientists are exploring new ways to save energy.
examples.dst: 科学家们正在探索节约能源的新方法。

confuse.diff: explore 意为探索；explode 意为爆炸。

examples.src: Mars is the fourth planet from the sun.
examples.dst: 火星是距离太阳第四近的行星。

examples.src: Scientists hope to send people to Mars one day.
examples.dst: 科学家们希望有朝一日把人送上火星。

examples.src: Mars is often called the red planet.
examples.dst: 火星常被称为红色星球。

confuse.diff: Mars 是火星；march 意为行军或三月（March）。

examples.src: It may rain, but we'll go anyhow.
examples.dst: 可能会下雨，但我们无论如何都要去。

examples.src: Anyhow, thank you for your help.
examples.dst: 不管怎样，谢谢你的帮助。

examples.src: Don't just do your homework anyhow.
examples.dst: 别随随便便地做作业。

confuse.diff: anyhow 和 anyway 意思相近，anyhow 还有随便地的意思。

examples.src: My goal is to become a doctor.
examples.dst: 我的目标是成为一名医生。

examples.src: He scored two goals in the second half.
examples.dst: 他在下半场进了两个球。

examples.src: We must work hard to reach our goal.
examples.dst: 我们必须努力实现目标。

confuse.diff: goal 意为目标、进球；gold 意为黄金。

examples.src: Money cannot buy happiness.
examples.dst: 金钱买不来幸福。

examples.src: She cried tears of happiness.
examples.dst: 她流下了幸福的泪水。

examples.src: I wish you health and happiness.
examples.dst: 祝你健康幸福。

confuse.diff: happiness 是名词，意为幸福；happy 是形容词，意为快乐的。

examples.src: The human race faces many environmental problems.
examples.dst: 人类面临着许多环境问题。

examples.src: Scientists have made great progress for the human race.
examples.dst: 科学家们为人类做出了巨大贡献。

examples.src: The future of the human race depends on all of us.
examples.dst: 人类的未来取决于我们每一个人。

confuse.diff: human race 指整个人类；human being 指单个的人。

examples.src: She won an award for best supporting actress.
examples.dst: 她获得了最佳女配角奖。

examples.src: The supporting evidence is very strong.
examples.dst: 支持这一点的证据非常有力。

examples.src: He played a supporting role in the team.
examples.dst: 他在团队中起辅助作用。

confuse.diff: supporting 指起支撑或辅助作用的；supportive 指给予支持和鼓励的。

examples.src: I downloaded a new app to my phone.
examples.dst: 我在手机上下载了一个新应用。

examples.src: It takes only a minute to download the file.
examples.dst: 下载这个文件只需要一分钟。

examples.src: You can download the free version online.
examples.dst: 你可以在网上下载免费版本。

confuse.diff: download 是下载；upload 是上传。

examples.src: My uncle is a computer programmer.
examples.dst: 我叔叔是一名计算机程序员。

examples.src: The programmer fixed the bug in an hour.
examples.dst: 程序员一个小时就修好了这个漏洞。

examples.src: She wants to become a software programmer.
examples.dst: 她想成为一名软件程序员。

confuse.diff: programmer 是程序员；program 是程序或节目。

examples.src: The flu is caused by a virus.
examples.dst: 流感是由病毒引起的。

examples.src: A virus has infected my computer.
examples.dst: 我的电脑感染了病毒。

examples.src: Wash your hands to stop the spread of the virus.
examples.dst: 勤洗手可以阻止病毒传播。

confuse.diff: virus 是病毒；bacteria 是细菌。

examples.src: The film is about an android that looks like a human.
examples.dst: 这部电影讲的是一个外表像人的机器人。

examples.src: Many phones run on the Android system.
examples.dst: 许多手机运行安卓系统。

examples.src: The android walked and talked like a real person.
examples.dst: 这个机器人走路说话都像真人一样。

confuse.diff: android 专指外形像人的机器人；robot 泛指各种机器人。

examples.src: I can't get a signal on my phone here.
examples.dst: 我在这儿手机没有信号。

examples.src: The driver signaled to turn left.
examples.dst: 司机打信号要向左转。

examples.src: The red light is a signal to stop.
examples.dst: 红灯是停车的信号。

confuse.diff: signal 意为信号；single 意为单一的、单身的。

examples.src: He passed the ball to his teammate.
examples.dst: 他把球传给了队友。

examples.src: My teammates cheered for me.
examples.dst: 我的队友们为我加油。

examples.src: A good teammate always helps others.
examples.dst: 好的队友总是帮助别人。

confuse.diff: teammate 是队友；classmate 是同班同学。

examples.src: Nagoya is a large city in central Japan.
examples.dst: 名古屋是日本中部的一座大城市。

examples.src: The 2026 Asian Games will be held in Nagoya.
examples.dst: 2026年亚运会将在名古屋举行。

examples.src: We took the train from Tokyo to Nagoya.
examples.dst: 我们乘火车从东京去了名古屋。

examples.src: What type of music do you like?
examples.dst: 你喜欢哪种类型的音乐？

examples.src: She can type very fast.
examples.dst: 她打字很快。

examples.src: Please type your name in the box.
examples.dst: 请在框中输入你的名字。

confuse.diff: type 意为类型、打字；tape 意为胶带、磁带。

examples.src: In a way, he is right.
examples.dst: 在某种程度上，他是对的。

examples.src: In a way, the failure was a good lesson.
examples.dst: 从某种意义上说，这次失败是一个很好的教训。

examples.src: I agree with you in a way.
examples.dst: 我在某种程度上同意你。

confuse.diff: in a way 意为在某种程度上；in the way 意为挡道。

examples.src: Our football coach is very strict.
examples.dst: 我们的足球教练非常严格。

examples.src: We went to Beijing by coach.
examples.dst: 我们乘长途汽车去了北京。

examples.src: She coaches the school basketball team.
examples.dst: 她负责训练学校篮球队。

confuse.diff: coach 意为教练、客车；couch 意为长沙发。

examples.src: A problem arose during the meeting.
examples.dst: 会议期间出现了一个问题。

examples.src: New questions arise as we learn more.
examples.dst: 随着了解的增多，新的问题不断出现。

examples.src: Misunderstandings often arise from poor communication.
examples.dst: 误解常常由沟通不畅引起。

confuse.diff: arise 是不及物动词，意为出现；raise 是及物动词，意为举起、提高。

examples.src: With the help of my teacher, I solved the problem.
examples.dst: 在老师的帮助下，我解决了这个问题。

examples.src: He finished the work with the help of his friends.
examples.dst: 他在朋友们的帮助下完成了工作。

examples.src: With the help of a map, we found the hotel.
examples.dst: 借助地图，我们找到了旅馆。

examples.src: He bought an electronic dictionary.
examples.dst: 他买了一本电子词典。

examples.src: Electronic devices are everywhere today.
examples.dst: 如今电子设备无处不在。

examples.src: You can send the document by electronic mail.
examples.dst: 你可以通过电子邮件发送这份文件。

confuse.diff: electronic 指电子的；electric 指电的、用电的。

examples.src: Don't judge people by their appearance.
examples.dst: 不要以貌取人。

examples.src: The singer made a surprise appearance at the party.
examples.dst: 这位歌手在聚会上意外露面。

examples.src: The appearance of the new model attracted many buyers.
examples.dst: 新款的问世吸引了许多买家。

confuse.diff: appearance 是名词，意为外貌、出现；appearing 是 appear 的现在分词。

examples.src: She has a strong character.
examples.dst: 她性格坚强。

examples.src: Harry Potter is my favorite character in the book.
examples.dst: 哈利·波特是我最喜欢的书中角色。

examples.src: Chinese characters are difficult to write.
examples.dst: 汉字很难写。

confuse.diff: character 指性格、角色；characteristic 指特征。

examples.src: She used a mop to clean the floor.
examples.dst: 她用拖把拖地。

examples.src: I mopped the kitchen after dinner.
examples.dst: 晚饭后我拖了厨房的地。

examples.src: He mopped the sweat from his face.
examples.dst: 他擦去了脸上的汗。

confuse.diff: mop 意为拖把；map 意为地图。

examples.src: How do you deal with stress?
examples.dst: 你如何应对压力？

examples.src: The manager will deal with the complaint.
examples.dst: 经理会处理这个投诉。

examples.src: This book deals with the history of science.
examples.dst: 这本书讲的是科学史。

confuse.diff: deal with 意为处理；deal in 意为经营某种商品。

examples.src: The nurse watched over the sick child all night.
examples.dst: 护士整夜照看着生病的孩子。

examples.src: Shepherds watch over their sheep.
examples.dst: 牧羊人看护着他们的羊群。

examples.src: A guard watches over the museum at night.
examples.dst: 夜里有一名警卫看守着博物馆。

confuse.diff: watch over 意为照看；watch out 意为当心。

examples.src: The naughty boy hid his sister's shoes.
examples.dst: 那个淘气的男孩把姐姐的鞋藏了起来。

examples.src: Don't be naughty in class.
examples.dst: 上课不要调皮。

examples.src: Our puppy is very naughty.
examples.dst: 我们的小狗很淘气。

confuse.diff: naughty 意为顽皮的；nought 意为零。

examples.src: My niece is five years old.
examples.dst: 我的侄女五岁了。

examples.src: She bought a gift for her niece.
examples.dst: 她给侄女买了一份礼物。

examples.src: His niece lives in Canada.
examples.dst: 他的外甥女住在加拿大。

confuse.diff: niece 是侄女、外甥女；nephew 是侄子、外甥。

examples.src: Don't spoil your children with too many gifts.
examples.dst: 别用太多礼物把孩子宠坏。

examples.src: The rain spoiled our picnic.
examples.dst: 这场雨破坏了我们的野餐。

examples.src: Milk spoils quickly in hot weather.
examples.dst: 牛奶在炎热的天气里很快变质。

confuse.diff: spoil 意为宠坏、破坏；spill 意为洒出。

examples.src: The park is home to a lot of wildlife.
examples.dst: 这个公园是许多野生动物的家园。

examples.src: We should protect wildlife and its habitat.
examples.dst: 我们应该保护野生动物及其栖息地。

examples.src: She is interested in wildlife photography.
examples.dst: 她对野生动物摄影感兴趣。

confuse.diff: wildlife 是名词，意为野生生物；wild 是形容词，意为野生的。

examples.src: Environmental protection is everyone's duty.
examples.dst: 保护环境是每个人的责任。

examples.src: Wear a hat for protection against the sun.
examples.dst: 戴上帽子防晒。

examples.src: The law gives protection to endangered animals.
examples.dst: 法律保护濒危动物。

confuse.diff: protection 是名词；protective 是形容词，意为保护的。

examples.src: Wild animals should live in the wild.
examples.dst: 野生动物应该生活在野外。

examples.src: The wild wind blew all night.
examples.dst: 狂风整夜呼啸。

examples.src: These wild flowers grow on the mountain.
examples.dst: 这些野花长在山上。

confuse.diff: wild 意为野生的；wide 意为宽的。

examples.src: Forests are the natural habitat of many animals.
examples.dst: 森林是许多动物的天然栖息地。

examples.src: Pollution is destroying their habitat.
examples.dst: 污染正在破坏它们的栖息地。

examples.src: The panda's habitat is mainly bamboo forest.
examples.dst: 大熊猫的栖息地主要是竹林。

confuse.diff: habitat 意为栖息地；habit 意为习惯。

examples.src: Pollution threatens the health of local people.
examples.dst: 污染威胁着当地人的健康。

examples.src: He threatened to call the police.
examples.dst: 他威胁说要报警。

examples.src: Heavy clouds threatened rain.
examples.dst: 乌云密布，眼看要下雨了。

confuse.diff: threaten 是动词，意为威胁；threat 是名词，意为威胁。

examples.src: The number of tigers has decreased sharply.
examples.dst: 老虎的数量急剧减少。

examples.src: There was a decrease in the price of oil.
examples.dst: 石油价格下降了。

examples.src: Sales decreased by ten percent last month.
examples.dst: 上个月销售额下降了百分之十。

confuse.diff: decrease 强调数量减少；decline 强调衰退、下降，也可指婉拒。

examples.src: Hunting endangers many species.
examples.dst: 狩猎使许多物种濒临危险。

examples.src: Smoking endangers your health.
examples.dst: 吸烟危害你的健康。

examples.src: The panda is an endangered animal.
examples.dst: 大熊猫是濒危动物。

confuse.diff: endanger 是动词，意为危及；danger 是名词，意为危险。

examples.src: Dinosaurs died out millions of years ago.
examples.dst: 恐龙在数百万年前就灭绝了。

examples.src: Many old customs are dying out.
examples.dst: 许多旧习俗正在消失。

examples.src: If we don't act, these animals will die out.
examples.dst: 如果我们不采取行动，这些动物将会灭绝。

confuse.diff: die out 意为灭绝；die down 意为逐渐减弱。

examples.src: The loss of habitat is a serious problem.
examples.dst: 栖息地的丧失是一个严重问题。

examples.src: The company suffered a heavy loss last year.
examples.dst: 这家公司去年遭受了巨额亏损。

examples.src: She was sad about the loss of her dog.
examples.dst: 她为失去小狗而难过。

confuse.diff: loss 是名词，意为损失；lose 是动词，意为丢失、输。

examples.src: The panda reserve was set up in 1963.
examples.dst: 这个熊猫保护区建于1963年。

examples.src: I'd like to reserve a table for four.
examples.dst: 我想预订一张四人桌。

examples.src: The country has large oil reserves.
examples.dst: 这个国家有大量石油储备。

confuse.diff: reserve 意为预订、保留；deserve 意为应得。

examples.src: Lions hunt in groups.
examples.dst: 狮子成群捕猎。

examples.src: The police are hunting for the missing boy.
examples.dst: 警方正在搜寻失踪的男孩。

examples.src: It is illegal to hunt wild animals here.
examples.dst: 在这里猎杀野生动物是违法的。

confuse.diff: hunt 意为打猎；hurt 意为伤害。

examples.src: This is a no-parking zone.
examples.dst: 这里是禁止停车区。

examples.src: The city has a new economic zone.
examples.dst: 这座城市有一个新的经济区。

examples.src: The flood hit a large danger zone.
examples.dst: 洪水袭击了一大片危险地带。

confuse.diff: zone 意为区域；zoom 意为飞速移动或镜头拉近。

examples.src: The animals live in peace in the reserve.
examples.dst: 动物们在保护区里安宁地生活。

examples.src: Let me work in peace.
examples.dst: 让我安静地工作。

examples.src: The two countries lived in peace for many years.
examples.dst: 这两个国家和平共处了许多年。

confuse.diff: in peace 意为平静地；in pieces 意为成碎片。

examples.src: The tiger is in danger of dying out.
examples.dst: 老虎面临灭绝的危险。

examples.src: The children were in danger when the river rose.
examples.dst: 河水上涨时孩子们处境危险。

examples.src: Don't put yourself in danger.
examples.dst: 不要让自己身处险境。

confuse.diff: in danger 指处于危险中；dangerous 指某事物危险。

examples.src: Many species are in danger of dying out.
examples.dst: 许多物种面临灭绝的危险。

examples.src: This rare species lives only in China.
examples.dst: 这种珍稀物种只生活在中国。

examples.src: Scientists have found a new species of frog.
examples.dst: 科学家发现了一种新的青蛙物种。

confuse.diff: species 意为物种；special 意为特别的。

examples.src: There is a red carpet in the living room.
examples.dst: 客厅里铺着一块红地毯。

examples.src: She vacuumed the carpet this morning.
examples.dst: 她今天早上用吸尘器清理了地毯。

examples.src: A carpet of snow covered the ground.
examples.dst: 一层白雪覆盖了大地。

confuse.diff: carpet 意为地毯；carrot 意为胡萝卜。

examples.src: He didn't respond to my email.
examples.dst: 他没有回复我的电子邮件。

examples.src: The patient responded well to the treatment.
examples.dst: 病人对治疗反应良好。

examples.src: Firefighters responded quickly to the call.
examples.dst: 消防员迅速对报警做出了反应。

confuse.diff: respond 是动词，意为回应；response 是名词，意为回应。

examples.src: We could see distant mountains from the window.
examples.dst: 我们从窗口能看到远处的群山。

examples.src: He is a distant relative of mine.
examples.dst: 他是我的远亲。

examples.src: She has a distant look in her eyes.
examples.dst: 她的眼神显得很疏离。

confuse.diff: distant 是形容词，意为遥远的；distance 是名词，意为距离。

examples.src: The cat has soft white fur.
examples.dst: 这只猫有柔软的白色毛发。

examples.src: She wore a coat with a fur collar.
examples.dst: 她穿着一件带毛皮领子的外套。

examples.src: Many animals are hunted for their fur.
examples.dst: 许多动物因为毛皮而被猎杀。

confuse.diff: fur 意为毛皮；fir 意为冷杉。

examples.src: The antelope can run very fast.
examples.dst: 羚羊跑得非常快。

examples.src: A herd of antelopes crossed the grassland.
examples.dst: 一群羚羊穿过了草原。

examples.src: Tibetan antelopes are protected by law.
examples.dst: 藏羚羊受到法律保护。

confuse.diff: antelope 是羚羊；elephant 是大象。

examples.src: It was a great relief to hear that she was safe.
examples.dst: 听到她平安无事，我感到十分宽慰。

examples.src: This medicine gives quick relief from pain.
examples.dst: 这种药能迅速缓解疼痛。

examples.src: The government sent relief to the flood area.
examples.dst: 政府向灾区发放了救济物资。

confuse.diff: relief 是名词，意为宽慰；relieve 是动词，意为减轻。

examples.src: She sighed in relief when the exam was over.
examples.dst: 考试结束后，她松了一口气。

examples.src: He smiled in relief at the good news.
examples.dst: 听到好消息，他如释重负地笑了。

examples.src: They cheered in relief when the rain stopped.
examples.dst: 雨停了，他们欢呼着松了一口气。

confuse.diff: in relief 意为如释重负地；in belief 意为在信念中。

examples.src: The room was full of laughter.
examples.dst: 房间里充满了笑声。

examples.src: We heard children's laughter in the garden.
examples.dst: 我们听到花园里传来孩子们的笑声。

examples.src: She couldn't hold back her laughter.
examples.dst: 她忍不住笑了出来。

confuse.diff: laughter 意为笑声；slaughter 意为屠宰、屠杀。

examples.src: The class burst into laughter at his joke.
examples.dst: 全班同学听了他的笑话哄堂大笑。

examples.src: She burst into laughter when she saw the funny hat.
examples.dst: 她看到那顶滑稽的帽子时突然大笑起来。

examples.src: We all burst into laughter at the same time.
examples.dst: 我们都同时大笑起来。

confuse.diff: burst into laughter 意为突然大笑；burst into tears 意为突然大哭。

examples.src: The judge showed mercy to the young man.
examples.dst: 法官对这个年轻人宽大处理。

examples.src: The hunters showed no mercy to the animals.
examples.dst: 猎人对这些动物毫不留情。

examples.src: The villagers were at the mercy of the storm.
examples.dst: 村民们任凭暴风雨摆布。

confuse.diff: mercy 意为仁慈；mercury 意为水银或水星。

examples.src: I am certain that he will come.
examples.dst: 我确信他会来。

examples.src: It is certain that prices will rise.
examples.dst: 物价肯定会上涨。

examples.src: A certain person called you this morning.
examples.dst: 今天早上有个人给你打过电话。

confuse.diff: certain 意为确定的；curtain 意为窗帘。

examples.src: We should realize the importance of protecting wildlife.
examples.dst: 我们应该认识到保护野生动物的重要性。

examples.src: The teacher stressed the importance of reading.
examples.dst: 老师强调了阅读的重要性。

examples.src: This matter is of great importance.
examples.dst: 这件事非常重要。

confuse.diff: importance 是名词，意为重要性；important 是形容词，意为重要的。

means: 世界自然基金会（World Wide Fund for Nature）

examples.src: The WWF works to protect endangered animals.
examples.dst: 世界自然基金会致力于保护濒危动物。

examples.src: The panda is the symbol of the WWF.
examples.dst: 大熊猫是世界自然基金会的标志。

examples.src: She donated money to the WWF.
examples.dst: 她向世界自然基金会捐了款。

examples.src: He rubbed his hands to keep warm.
examples.dst: 他搓着手取暖。

examples.src: Rub the table with a dry cloth.
examples.dst: 用干布擦桌子。

examples.src: She rubbed her eyes and yawned.
examples.dst: 她揉了揉眼睛，打了个哈欠。

confuse.diff: rub 意为擦；rob 意为抢劫。

examples.src: A hat can protect you from the sun.
examples.dst: 帽子可以保护你不被太阳晒伤。

examples.src: We must protect the forest from fire.
examples.dst: 我们必须保护森林免受火灾。

examples.src: Vaccines protect people from serious diseases.
examples.dst: 疫苗保护人们免受严重疾病的侵害。

confuse.diff: protect…from 意为保护免受；prevent…from 意为阻止做某事。

examples.src: A mosquito bit me last night.
examples.dst: 昨晚一只蚊子咬了我。

examples.src: Mosquitoes can spread diseases.
examples.dst: 蚊子会传播疾病。

examples.src: We used a net to keep the mosquitoes out.
examples.dst: 我们用网挡住蚊子。

confuse.diff: mosquito 意为蚊子；mosque 意为清真寺。

examples.src: A millipede crawled across the wet ground.
examples.dst: 一只千足虫爬过潮湿的地面。

examples.src: Millipedes usually live in dark, damp places.
examples.dst: 千足虫通常生活在阴暗潮湿的地方。

examples.src: The millipede has many pairs of legs.
examples.dst: 千足虫有许多对足。

confuse.diff: millipede 每节有两对足；centipede（蜈蚣）每节有一对足。

examples.src: Bees and ants are insects.
examples.dst: 蜜蜂和蚂蚁都是昆虫。

examples.src: Some insects are harmful to crops.
examples.dst: 有些昆虫对庄稼有害。

examples.src: She is studying insects for her biology project.
examples.dst: 她正在为生物课题研究昆虫。

confuse.diff: insect 意为昆虫；inspect 意为检查。

examples.src: This bottle contains one liter of water.
examples.dst: 这个瓶子装有一升水。

examples.src: The book contains many useful pictures.
examples.dst: 这本书包含许多有用的图片。

examples.src: She could hardly contain her excitement.
examples.dst: 她几乎抑制不住内心的兴奋。

confuse.diff: contain 意为包含；continue 意为继续。

examples.src: The lion is a powerful animal.
examples.dst: 狮子是一种强大的动物。

examples.src: She gave a powerful speech.
examples.dst: 她发表了一场有力的演讲。

examples.src: This is a powerful computer.
examples.dst: 这是一台性能强大的电脑。

confuse.diff: powerful 是形容词，意为强大的；power 是名词，意为力量。

examples.src: Air pollution affects our health.
examples.dst: 空气污染影响我们的健康。

examples.src: The bad news affected her deeply.
examples.dst: 这个坏消息使她深受触动。

examples.src: The disease affects mainly old people.
examples.dst: 这种疾病主要侵袭老年人。

confuse.diff: affect 是动词，意为影响；effect 通常是名词，意为效果。

examples.src: May I have your attention, please?
examples.dst: 请大家注意一下好吗？

examples.src: The child needs a lot of attention.
examples.dst: 这个孩子需要很多照顾。

examples.src: The accident drew the attention of the media.
examples.dst: 这起事故引起了媒体的关注。

confuse.diff: attention 意为注意；intention 意为意图。

examples.src: Please pay attention to the teacher.
examples.dst: 请注意听老师讲课。

examples.src: We should pay attention to our health.
examples.dst: 我们应该注意自己的健康。

examples.src: He paid no attention to the warning.
examples.dst: 他对警告毫不在意。

confuse.diff: pay attention to 是自己注意；draw attention to 是引起别人注意。

examples.src: I really appreciate your help.
examples.dst: 我真的很感激你的帮助。

examples.src: We went to the museum to appreciate the paintings.
examples.dst: 我们去博物馆欣赏画作。

examples.src: She appreciates the value of hard work.
examples.dst: 她懂得努力工作的价值。

confuse.diff: appreciate 是动词；appreciation 是名词，意为感激、欣赏。

examples.src: If you work hard, you will succeed.
examples.dst: 只要努力，你就会成功。

examples.src: She succeeded in passing the exam.
examples.dst: 她成功通过了考试。

examples.src: The prince succeeded his father as king.
examples.dst: 王子继承父亲成为国王。

confuse.diff: succeed 是动词，意为成功；success 是名词，意为成功。

examples.src: The rhino has a horn on its nose.
examples.dst: 犀牛鼻子上长着角。

examples.src: Rhinos are hunted for their horns.
examples.dst: 犀牛因为犀角而遭到猎杀。

examples.src: We saw a rhino at the safari park.
examples.dst: 我们在野生动物园里看到了一头犀牛。

confuse.diff: rhino 是犀牛；hippo 是河马。

examples.src: The animals feel secure in the reserve.
examples.dst: 动物们在保护区里感觉很安全。

examples.src: He secured a job in a big company.
examples.dst: 他在一家大公司谋得了一份工作。

examples.src: Make sure the door is secure before you leave.
examples.dst: 离开前要确保门锁牢了。

confuse.diff: secure 是形容词或动词；security 是名词，意为安全。

examples.src: His monthly income is not high.
examples.dst: 他的月收入不高。

examples.src: Tourism is the main source of income here.
examples.dst: 旅游业是这里的主要收入来源。

examples.src: Families with low income get help from the government.
examples.dst: 低收入家庭可以得到政府的帮助。

confuse.diff: income 意为收入；outcome 意为结果。

examples.src: The factory employs about two hundred workers.
examples.dst: 这家工厂雇用了大约两百名工人。

examples.src: She was employed as a guide.
examples.dst: 她受雇做导游。

examples.src: Scientists employ new methods to protect wildlife.
examples.dst: 科学家们采用新方法保护野生动物。

confuse.diff: employ 是动词，意为雇用；employee 是名词，意为雇员。

examples.src: Smoking does great harm to your health.
examples.dst: 吸烟对你的健康危害很大。

examples.src: The storm did no harm to the village.
examples.dst: 暴风雨没有给村庄造成损害。

examples.src: Don't harm the little animals.
examples.dst: 不要伤害小动物。

confuse.diff: harm 是名词或动词；harmful 是形容词，意为有害的。

examples.src: The Milu deer was once nearly extinct in China.
examples.dst: 麋鹿曾在中国几乎灭绝。

examples.src: Milu deer are also called Père David's deer.
examples.dst: 麋鹿也被称为大卫神父鹿。

examples.src: We saw Milu deer in the nature reserve.
examples.dst: 我们在自然保护区里看到了麋鹿。

examples.src: The dog bit the postman.
examples.dst: 这条狗咬了邮递员。

examples.src: Mosquitoes bit me all over my arms.
examples.dst: 蚊子把我的胳膊咬得到处是包。

examples.src: She took a big bite of the apple.
examples.dst: 她大大地咬了一口苹果。

confuse.diff: bite 意为咬；beat 意为打、击败。

examples.src: Many species are facing extinction.
examples.dst: 许多物种正面临灭绝。

examples.src: The extinction of the dinosaurs happened long ago.
examples.dst: 恐龙灭绝发生在很久以前。

examples.src: We must save these animals from extinction.
examples.dst: 我们必须拯救这些动物，使它们免于灭绝。

confuse.diff: extinction 是名词，意为灭绝；extinct 是形容词，意为灭绝的。

examples.src: Dinosaurs lived on the earth millions of years ago.
examples.dst: 恐龙在数百万年前生活在地球上。

examples.src: The boy loves books about dinosaurs.
examples.dst: 这个男孩喜欢关于恐龙的书。

examples.src: We saw a dinosaur skeleton in the museum.
examples.dst: 我们在博物馆里看到了恐龙骨架。

confuse.diff: dinosaur 是真实存在过的恐龙；dragon 是神话中的龙。

examples.src: The club came into being in 1990.
examples.dst: 这个俱乐部成立于1990年。

examples.src: How did the universe come into being?
examples.dst: 宇宙是如何形成的？

examples.src: The new school came into being last year.
examples.dst: 这所新学校是去年建成的。

examples.src: He was born in a small county in Hubei.
examples.dst: 他出生在湖北的一个小县城。

examples.src: The county has a population of two hundred thousand.
examples.dst: 这个县有二十万人口。

examples.src: Kent is a county in the south of England.
examples.dst: 肯特郡是英格兰南部的一个郡。

confuse.diff: county 意为县、郡；country 意为国家。

examples.src: The officer inspected the passports carefully.
examples.dst: 官员仔细检查了护照。

examples.src: The headmaster inspected the classrooms.
examples.dst: 校长视察了各个教室。

examples.src: Workers inspect the machines every day.
examples.dst: 工人们每天检查机器。

confuse.diff: inspect 意为检查；inspire 意为激励。

examples.src: We had an unexpected visitor last night.
examples.dst: 昨晚我们来了一位不速之客。

examples.src: The result was quite unexpected.
examples.dst: 结果完全出乎意料。

examples.src: An unexpected storm ruined our trip.
examples.dst: 一场突如其来的暴风雨毁了我们的旅行。

confuse.diff: unexpected 是形容词；unexpectedly 是副词，意为出乎意料地。

examples.src: The police are investigating the incident.
examples.dst: 警方正在调查这一事件。

examples.src: A strange incident happened on the way home.
examples.dst: 回家的路上发生了一件怪事。

examples.src: The incident was soon forgotten.
examples.dst: 这件事很快就被遗忘了。

confuse.diff: incident 指一般事件；accident 指意外事故。

examples.src: There was dust all over the old books.
examples.dst: 旧书上到处是灰尘。

examples.src: She dusted the shelves every Saturday.
examples.dst: 她每个星期六都擦拭书架。

examples.src: The truck raised a cloud of dust.
examples.dst: 卡车扬起了一片尘土。

confuse.diff: dust 意为灰尘；duty 意为责任。

examples.src: According to the weather report, it will rain tomorrow.
examples.dst: 根据天气预报，明天会下雨。

examples.src: According to him, the museum opens at nine.
examples.dst: 据他说，博物馆九点开门。

examples.src: We will act according to your plan.
examples.dst: 我们将按照你的计划行事。

confuse.diff: according to 多指依据某人或某资料；in accordance with 多指遵照规定。

examples.src: The disappearance of the forests worries scientists.
examples.dst: 森林的消失让科学家们担忧。

examples.src: Police are looking into the girl's disappearance.
examples.dst: 警方正在调查这个女孩的失踪案。

examples.src: The disappearance of the dinosaurs is still a mystery.
examples.dst: 恐龙的消失至今仍是个谜。

confuse.diff: disappearance 意为消失；disappointment 意为失望。

examples.src: A fierce tiger appeared in front of us.
examples.dst: 一只凶猛的老虎出现在我们面前。

examples.src: The two teams had a fierce competition.
examples.dst: 两支队伍展开了激烈的比赛。

examples.src: A fierce wind blew down many trees.
examples.dst: 狂风吹倒了许多树。

confuse.diff: fierce 意为凶猛的；fire 意为火。

examples.src: Speak slowly so that everyone can understand.
examples.dst: 说慢一点，以便大家都能听懂。

examples.src: He got up early so that he wouldn't be late.
examples.dst: 他早起是为了不迟到。

examples.src: She worked hard so that she passed the exam.
examples.dst: 她努力学习，结果通过了考试。

confuse.diff: so that 引导目的或结果状语从句；so…that… 表示如此…以至于…。

examples.src: The film has a happy ending.
examples.dst: 这部电影有一个圆满的结局。

examples.src: I didn't like the ending of the story.
examples.dst: 我不喜欢这个故事的结尾。

examples.src: The ending of the book surprised everyone.
examples.dst: 这本书的结尾让所有人都感到意外。

confuse.diff: ending 是名词，意为结局；end 既可作名词也可作动词，意为结束。

examples.src: He served the company faithfully for thirty years.
examples.dst: 他忠心耿耿地为公司服务了三十年。

examples.src: The dog waited faithfully for its owner.
examples.dst: 这条狗忠实地等着主人。

examples.src: The film faithfully follows the original novel.
examples.dst: 这部电影忠实地遵循了原著小说。

confuse.diff: faithfully 是副词；faithful 是形容词，意为忠实的。

examples.src: The Colobus monkey lives in the forests of Africa.
examples.dst: 疣猴生活在非洲的森林里。

examples.src: Colobus monkeys have long black and white fur.
examples.dst: 疣猴有长长的黑白相间的毛。

examples.src: We watched a Colobus monkey jump between the trees.
examples.dst: 我们看着一只疣猴在树间跳跃。

examples.src: She enjoys listening to classical music.
examples.dst: 她喜欢听古典音乐。

examples.src: He is studying classical Chinese literature.
examples.dst: 他在研究中国古典文学。

examples.src: Classical ballet requires years of training.
examples.dst: 古典芭蕾需要多年的训练。

confuse.diff: classical 指古典的；classic 指经典的，也可指经典作品。

examples.src: The ball rolled down the hill.
examples.dst: 球顺着山坡滚了下去。

examples.src: She rolled up the poster and put it away.
examples.dst: 她把海报卷起来收好。

examples.src: We had soup and a bread roll for lunch.
examples.dst: 我们午饭吃了汤和一个小面包。

confuse.diff: roll 是滚动或卷；role 是角色。

examples.src: Rock'n'roll became popular in the 1950s.
examples.dst: 摇滚乐在二十世纪五十年代开始流行。

examples.src: My uncle loves old rock'n'roll songs.
examples.dst: 我叔叔喜欢老摇滚歌曲。

examples.src: Elvis Presley was called the king of rock'n'roll.
examples.dst: 埃尔维斯·普雷斯利被称为摇滚乐之王。

examples.src: The school orchestra will perform tonight.
examples.dst: 学校管弦乐队今晚演出。

examples.src: She plays the violin in the city orchestra.
examples.dst: 她在市管弦乐团拉小提琴。

examples.src: The orchestra was led by a famous conductor.
examples.dst: 这个乐团由一位著名指挥带领。

confuse.diff: orchestra 是管弦乐队；chorus 是合唱团。

examples.src: He writes his own rap songs.
examples.dst: 他自己创作说唱歌曲。

examples.src: The singer rapped about city life.
examples.dst: 歌手用说唱讲述城市生活。

examples.src: Someone rapped on the window.
examples.dst: 有人轻轻敲了敲窗户。

confuse.diff: rap 是说唱或轻敲；wrap 是包裹。

examples.src: She likes listening to folk music.
examples.dst: 她喜欢听民间音乐。

examples.src: Folk tales are passed down through generations.
examples.dst: 民间故事代代相传。

examples.src: Hi, folks! Welcome to our show.
examples.dst: 大家好！欢迎来到我们的节目。

confuse.diff: folk 是民间的；fork 是叉子。

examples.src: Jazz started in New Orleans.
examples.dst: 爵士乐起源于新奥尔良。

examples.src: They listened to jazz at the bar.
examples.dst: 他们在酒吧听爵士乐。

examples.src: He plays the saxophone in a jazz band.
examples.dst: 他在一支爵士乐队里吹萨克斯。

examples.src: Our school has a choral society.
examples.dst: 我们学校有一个合唱团。

examples.src: They sang a beautiful choral piece.
examples.dst: 他们演唱了一首优美的合唱曲。

examples.src: Choral music fills the church on Sundays.
examples.dst: 周日教堂里回荡着合唱音乐。

confuse.diff: choral 是合唱的；coral 是珊瑚。

means: 门基乐队（美国流行乐队）

examples.src: The Monkees were a popular band in the 1960s.
examples.dst: 门基乐队是二十世纪六十年代的流行乐队。

examples.src: My father has an old record by the Monkees.
examples.dst: 我父亲有一张门基乐队的旧唱片。

examples.src: The Monkees also starred in a TV show.
examples.dst: 门基乐队还主演过一档电视节目。

examples.src: She wants to be a professional musician.
examples.dst: 她想成为一名职业音乐人。

examples.src: The street musician played the guitar.
examples.dst: 街头音乐人弹着吉他。

examples.src: Many famous musicians came to the concert.
examples.dst: 许多著名音乐家来到了音乐会。

confuse.diff: musician 是音乐家；magician 是魔术师。

examples.src: He dreams of becoming a pilot.
examples.dst: 他梦想成为一名飞行员。

examples.src: I never dreamed of winning the prize.
examples.dst: 我从没想过会得奖。

examples.src: She dreamed of her hometown last night.
examples.dst: 她昨晚梦见了家乡。

confuse.diff: dream of 多指梦想；dream about 多指做梦梦到。

examples.src: We sang at a karaoke bar after the exam.
examples.dst: 考完试后我们去卡拉OK厅唱歌。

examples.src: Karaoke is popular among young people.
examples.dst: 卡拉OK在年轻人中很受欢迎。

examples.src: He picked a song from the karaoke machine.
examples.dst: 他从卡拉OK机里选了一首歌。

examples.src: He pretended to be asleep.
examples.dst: 他假装睡着了。

examples.src: Don't pretend that you understand.
examples.dst: 不要装作你听懂了。

examples.src: The children pretended to be pirates.
examples.dst: 孩子们假扮成海盗。

confuse.diff: pretend 是假装；intend 是打算。

examples.src: To be honest, I don't like the idea.
examples.dst: 说实话，我不喜欢这个主意。

examples.src: To be honest, I was a little afraid.
examples.dst: 老实说，我有点害怕。

examples.src: To be honest, the film was boring.
examples.dst: 说实话，这部电影很无聊。

confuse.diff: 两者意思相近；to be honest 更口语。

examples.src: Please attach a photo to your application.
examples.dst: 请在申请表上附一张照片。

examples.src: I attached the file to the email.
examples.dst: 我把文件附在了邮件里。

examples.src: She is deeply attached to her grandmother.
examples.dst: 她非常依恋自己的祖母。

confuse.diff: attach 是附上；attack 是攻击。

examples.src: He attached a note to the gift.
examples.dst: 他在礼物上附了一张便条。

examples.src: We attach great importance to education.
examples.dst: 我们十分重视教育。

examples.src: She attached the label to the bottle.
examples.dst: 她把标签贴在了瓶子上。

confuse.diff: attach…to… 是把…附在…上；attend to 是处理。

examples.src: Please fill in this form.
examples.dst: 请填写这张表格。

examples.src: Water can take the form of ice or steam.
examples.dst: 水可以呈现冰或蒸汽的形态。

examples.src: They formed a band at school.
examples.dst: 他们在学校组建了一支乐队。

confuse.diff: form 是形式或形成；from 表示来自。

examples.src: The singer rose to fame at the age of twenty.
examples.dst: 这位歌手二十岁时成名。

examples.src: Fame did not change her.
examples.dst: 名声并没有改变她。

examples.src: He achieved fame and fortune.
examples.dst: 他名利双收。

confuse.diff: fame 是名词；famous 是形容词。

examples.src: A passer-by called the police.
examples.dst: 一位路人报了警。

examples.src: The street singer was heard by many passers-by.
examples.dst: 许多路人听到了街头歌手的演唱。

examples.src: Passers-by stopped to watch the show.
examples.dst: 路人停下来观看表演。

examples.src: He earns a good salary.
examples.dst: 他的薪水不错。

examples.src: She earned money by tutoring students.
examples.dst: 她靠给学生辅导挣钱。

examples.src: Her hard work earned her respect.
examples.dst: 她的勤奋为她赢得了尊重。

confuse.diff: earn 是挣钱；learn 是学习。

examples.src: I need some extra time to finish it.
examples.dst: 我需要一些额外的时间完成它。

examples.src: Breakfast is an extra charge.
examples.dst: 早餐需要额外收费。

examples.src: He worked as an extra in a film.
examples.dst: 他在一部电影里当群众演员。

confuse.diff: extra 是额外的；extract 是提取。

examples.src: Can you play any musical instrument?
examples.dst: 你会演奏什么乐器吗？

examples.src: The doctor checked the instruments before surgery.
examples.dst: 医生在手术前检查了器械。

examples.src: The piano is her favourite instrument.
examples.dst: 钢琴是她最喜欢的乐器。

confuse.diff: instrument 是乐器或仪器；instruction 是说明或指示。

examples.src: The band will perform on Saturday.
examples.dst: 乐队将在周六演出。

examples.src: The doctor performed the operation successfully.
examples.dst: 医生成功地完成了手术。

examples.src: She performs well under pressure.
examples.dst: 她在压力下表现出色。

confuse.diff: perform 是表演；perfume 是香水。

examples.src: The performance begins at seven.
examples.dst: 演出七点开始。

examples.src: His performance in the exam was excellent.
examples.dst: 他在考试中表现出色。

examples.src: The audience clapped after her performance.
examples.dst: 她表演结束后观众鼓起了掌。

confuse.diff: performance 是名词；perform 是动词。

examples.src: They met at a pub near the station.
examples.dst: 他们在车站附近的一家酒馆见面。

examples.src: The pub has live music on Fridays.
examples.dst: 这家酒馆周五有现场音乐。

examples.src: In Britain, pubs are an important part of social life.
examples.dst: 在英国，酒馆是社交生活的重要部分。

confuse.diff: pub 是英式酒馆；club 是俱乐部或夜总会。

examples.src: Do you have any cash on you?
examples.dst: 你身上有现金吗？

examples.src: I'll pay in cash.
examples.dst: 我付现金。

examples.src: He cashed a cheque at the bank.
examples.dst: 他在银行兑现了一张支票。

confuse.diff: cash 是现金；cache 是隐藏处或缓存。

examples.src: The shop only accepts payment in cash.
examples.dst: 这家店只收现金。

examples.src: She paid for the bike in cash.
examples.dst: 她用现金买了自行车。

examples.src: Can I pay in cash or by card?
examples.dst: 我可以付现金还是刷卡？

confuse.diff: in cash 是用现金；in case 是以防万一。

examples.src: The band is recording in a studio.
examples.dst: 乐队正在录音室录音。

examples.src: The painter works in a bright studio.
examples.dst: 画家在一间明亮的画室里工作。

examples.src: The TV studio was full of cameras.
examples.dst: 电视演播室里摆满了摄像机。

confuse.diff: studio 是工作室；study 是学习或书房。

examples.src: He became a millionaire at thirty.
examples.dst: 他三十岁就成了百万富翁。

examples.src: The millionaire gave money to the school.
examples.dst: 这位富翁向学校捐了钱。

examples.src: Not everyone dreams of being a millionaire.
examples.dst: 并不是每个人都梦想成为百万富翁。

confuse.diff: millionaire 是百万富翁；million 是一百万。

examples.src: He likes to play jokes on his friends.
examples.dst: 他喜欢捉弄朋友。

examples.src: Don't play jokes on strangers.
examples.dst: 不要捉弄陌生人。

examples.src: The students played a joke on the teacher.
examples.dst: 学生们对老师开了个玩笑。

confuse.diff: play jokes on 是开玩笑；make fun of 带有嘲笑的意思。

examples.src: He is a famous film actor.
examples.dst: 他是一位著名的电影演员。

examples.src: The actor won an award for his role.
examples.dst: 这位演员因这个角色获奖。

examples.src: She dreams of becoming an actor.
examples.dst: 她梦想成为一名演员。

confuse.diff: actor 指男演员，也可泛指演员；actress 指女演员。

means: 依靠；依赖（常与 on 连用）

examples.src: You can rely on me.
examples.dst: 你可以依靠我。

examples.src: We rely on the internet for information.
examples.dst: 我们靠网络获取信息。

examples.src: Don't rely too much on others.
examples.dst: 不要过分依赖别人。

confuse.diff: rely 是依靠；reply 是回答。

examples.src: Farmers rely on rain for their crops.
examples.dst: 农民的庄稼靠雨水。

examples.src: I can always rely on my friends.
examples.dst: 我总能依靠我的朋友们。

examples.src: Many people rely on their phones every day.
examples.dst: 许多人每天都依赖手机。

confuse.diff: rely on 是依靠；reply to 是回复。

examples.src: The match will be broadcast live.
examples.dst: 这场比赛将进行现场直播。

examples.src: The radio station broadcasts news every hour.
examples.dst: 电台每小时播报新闻。

examples.src: We listened to a broadcast about the weather.
examples.dst: 我们听了一段天气广播。

confuse.diff: broadcast 是广播；forecast 是预报。

examples.src: He gave a humorous speech.
examples.dst: 他发表了一场幽默的演讲。

examples.src: The story is humorous and easy to read.
examples.dst: 这个故事幽默易读。

examples.src: She has a humorous way of talking.
examples.dst: 她说话很风趣。

confuse.diff: humorous 是形容词；humour 是名词，意为幽默。

examples.src: This song sounds familiar.
examples.dst: 这首歌听起来很耳熟。

examples.src: The streets were familiar to him.
examples.dst: 他对这些街道很熟悉。

examples.src: She saw a familiar face in the crowd.
examples.dst: 她在人群中看到一张熟悉的面孔。

confuse.diff: familiar 是熟悉的；family 是家庭。

examples.src: Are you familiar with this software?
examples.dst: 你熟悉这款软件吗？

examples.src: He is familiar with the history of the city.
examples.dst: 他熟知这座城市的历史。

examples.src: I am not familiar with the rules of the game.
examples.dst: 我不熟悉这个游戏的规则。

confuse.diff: be familiar with 主语是人，意为熟悉；be familiar to 主语是事物，意为被人熟悉。

examples.src: It takes time to get familiar with a new school.
examples.dst: 熟悉一所新学校需要时间。

examples.src: Please get familiar with the safety rules.
examples.dst: 请熟悉安全规则。

examples.src: I'm getting familiar with the city.
examples.dst: 我正在逐渐熟悉这座城市。

confuse.diff: get familiar with 强调熟悉的过程；be familiar with 强调熟悉的状态。

examples.src: It took an hour or so to get there.
examples.dst: 到那儿花了一个小时左右。

examples.src: There were fifty or so people in the hall.
examples.dst: 大厅里大约有五十个人。

examples.src: He waited ten minutes or so.
examples.dst: 他等了十分钟左右。

confuse.diff: or so 是大约；or else 是否则。

examples.src: The band broke up after ten years.
examples.dst: 乐队在十年后解散了。

examples.src: She broke up with her boyfriend.
examples.dst: 她和男朋友分手了。

examples.src: School breaks up for summer in July.
examples.dst: 学校七月放暑假。

confuse.diff: break up 是分手或解散；break down 是出故障或崩溃。

examples.src: The family was reunited after ten years.
examples.dst: 这个家庭十年后重新团聚了。

examples.src: The band reunited for a farewell concert.
examples.dst: 乐队为告别演唱会重新聚在一起。

examples.src: The two brothers reunited at the airport.
examples.dst: 两兄弟在机场重逢。

confuse.diff: reunite 是动词；reunion 是名词，意为团聚。
